encode_string_to_bytes: encode a string into space-separated byte characters using the Bytes BPE encoder
decode_bytes_to_string: decode space-separated byte characters back into the original string using the Bytes decoder
register_bytes_bpe: register the bytes BPE encoder with fairseq using the register_bpe decorator
review_bytes_encode_decode: review the Bytes class encode and decode methods for byte-level tokenization
test_bytes_roundtrip: test the Bytes encoder by encoding a string and decoding it back to verify roundtrip
